name: SQL
purpose: SQL solves the problem of interacting with structured data efficiently, enabling data scientists to extract, preprocess, and analyze large datasets. It is crucial for preparing high-quality data for predictive modeling, exploratory data analysis, and feature engineering, acting as a foundational bridge between raw data and analytical insights.
coreComponents: Data Manipulation Language (DML) - e.g., INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
Data Definition Language (DDL) - e.g., CREATE, ALTER, DROP
Data Control Language (DCL) - e.g., GRANT, REVOKE
keyCapabilities: Efficiently querying and retrieving specific data from large datasets.
Filtering, sorting, and aggregating data for summarization and analysis.
Joining multiple tables to combine related data.
Manipulating data through insertion, updating, and deletion.
Creating and managing database schemas, tables, and views.
integrations: Programming languages like Python and R.
Business Intelligence (BI) tools such as Tableau and Power BI.
Cloud data platforms including Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, and Snowflake.
Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS) like MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and SQL Server.
useCases: Data extraction and preprocessing for machine learning models.
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to understand data patterns and correlations.
Feature engineering to create new variables for improved model performance.
Building and managing data pipelines (ETL processes).
